Question: In Table 1 of the EIA Massachusetts Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for Electric utilities?

A. 20,367,858 megawatthours
B. 547,032 megawatthours

Source citation: Massachusetts Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/massachusetts/index.php)

Source text:
Massachusetts Electricity Profile 2024

Table 1. 2024 Summary statistics (Massachusetts)

| Item | Value | Rank |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Net summer capacity (megawatts) | 11,505 | 35 |
| Electric utilities | 1,030 | 42 |
| IPP & CHP | 10,476 | 12 |
| Net generation (megawatthours) | 20,914,890 | 41 |
| Electric utilities | 547,032 | 43 |
| IPP & CHP | 20,367,858 | 22 |

Data source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-860, Annual Electric Generator Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-861, Annual Electric Power Industry Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-923, Power Plant Operations Report and predecessor forms.
